message:
fix(keepalive-multi r1): a PC still finishing its handshake is alive; the list counts down without churning

Found on the 2-host AVD run (km_r2): B's directory connect came up but nativeActivate
refused it -- the table's reap ended B as "peer_lost" because Alive() counted only
Connected, and right after Connect the session can still be Connecting. Alive() is now
"not ended" (Connected or Connecting); only Disconnected / Error is taken off. A refused
activation logs the table (no token, no address).
The kept PCs' cards showed the time left fixed at the park's start (5:00); re-binding
the list every tick then kept the screen from settling (uiautomator could not read it,
km_r3). The card now shows minutes ("5분" ... "59초") and the list is re-bound only
when what a card shows changes.
TEST BUILD ONLY: GNLinkStreamPinnedSelectTest takes its machine id from
REMOTE60_PINNED_TEST_MACHINE_ID (directory_client.cpp, under
REMOTE60_PINNED_SELECT_TEST_SEAM), so two fixture hosts on one PC get two hostIds; the
e2e harness paints a --target-mark colour square so a phone screenshot names the PC.
Shipped GNLinkStream.exe carries no such string (0; pinned test exe 1).
km_r4 (two fail-closed pinned test hosts, fixture APK a5cd6504, cold AVD): 20/20 --
A new -> park -> B new beside A -> park (both kept, each with its own 끊기) -> A reuse
(A's connects/hellos/observes/punches 1/1/1/1 unchanged) -> B reuse -> A's 끊기 ends A
only -> B still reused -> 연결 해제 -> sign-out; 5 codecs, every first input an IDR;
screenshots A magenta / B cyan. Host logs: one connection per host, steady park 0
encoded / 0 video datagrams, control 0.5-1.3 KB/s.
gradle assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest (plain): BUILD SUCCESSFUL, unit 213/0.
